reviews.text: Great service, friendly groomers. Reasonable pricing.

The only place I will take my pup. Truly proven professional groomers. They make sure to know your desires going in. They make sure you know the things to consider for the future.  Always consultative and the skills to back it!
They always take such good care of our girls.
We love it! After a morning at the beach we come for a clean up!
Thru do a great job!  I have an 80 lb. Black Lab and she LOVES coming here for grooming.
Janelle always makes sure our dog, Kaia feels comfortable. This is the first groomer Kaia enjoys going to!

We’ve been with them for over 15 years and our 2 cats were crazy and finicky when being touched by other people but both of them loved going there as their groomers were fantastic and kind to all of the animals there that I have seen!🥰 …
Best in San Diego. Took my pup, the late Baxter, there for years. Wonderful staff and they LOVE dogs
